title: Annotatio III §.II: From the Reformed side — Wittenberg Formula never revoked, only declared; Helvetian approval; Zurich reply dated 4 May 1538 (not 1539 typo in Werenfels)
pass_a_gloss: FROM THE REFORMERS’ SIDE, that the Wittenberg Formula of Concord was never revoked, but only declared — see Crocius, Commentary on the Augsburg Confession, p. 162; approved seal-by-seal by the Helvetians, Crocius pp. 100 and 107; of which approval, inasmuch as it has been called into doubt by some, we cannot but summon as witnesses the Helvetians’ reply-letters given a little later from Zurich to Luther; yet not only in the Year 1539 at last — to which year, perhaps by typographical error, I find them assigned in a part of the Werenfelsian Sermon printed at Berlin in this very year in which I write — but written in the Year 1538, on the 4th day of May, and so about half a year after Luther’s Epistle had been returned to them, as the three most celebrated Lutheran writers of the History of the Augsburg Confession — Selneccer, Kirchner, and Chemnitz — recount, reviewing the said letters in the following words:
pass_b_english: From the Reformed side: the Wittenberg Formula of Concord was never revoked — only declared (Crocius on the Augsburg Confession, p. 162).
The Swiss approved it point by point (Crocius, pp. 100 and 107).

Because some have doubted that approval, we must call the Helvetians’ own reply letters from Zurich to Luther as witnesses — written a little later, yet not as late as 1539 (the year a Berlin printing of Werenfels’s sermon assigns them, perhaps by typographical error, in this very year of my writing).

They were drawn up on 4 May 1538 — about half a year after Luther’s letter reached them — as Selneccer, Kirchner, and Chemnitz, the three most celebrated Lutheran historians of the Augsburg Confession, recount when they cite the letters in these words:
source_text: A PARTE REFORMATORUM Formulam Concordiae Wittenbergensem nunquam fuisse revocatam, sed declaratam duntaxat vid. Crocium, Comment. August. Confess. pag. 162. sigillatim ab Helvetiis approbatam, Croc. pag. 100. & 107. cujus approbationis, quippe à nonnullis in dubium vocatae, non possumus non testes Helvetiorum advocare responsorias paulò licèt seriùs Tiguro, ad Lutherum datas; non tamen Annô demum 1539. cui anno, fortè per errorem typographicum, assignatas eas invenio in parte Concionis Werenfelsianae, hôc ipsô, quô haec scribo, annô, Berolini typis exscripta, sed exaratas Anno 1538, die 4. Maji, adeoque dimidio circiter post anno à reddita sibi Lutheri Epistola, uti memorant Historiae Augustanae Confess. Scriptores tres Lutheranorum celebratissimi, Selneccerus, Kirchnerus & Chemnitius, dictas literas verbis sequentibus recensentes:

lemmas.latin: nunquam fuisse revocatam, sed declaratam duntaxat
lemmas.gloss: was never revoked, but only declared

choices.english: point by point / one by one

notes: Hexades Annotatio III §.II densify §206; Reformed non-revocation and Zurich date correction before German letter.
